Digital solution: Digital systems for managing return, readmission and reintegration of third- country nationals.
Main mandated functionaliti es: Such systems should manage return, readmission and reintegration of third- country nationals.
How is accessibility catered for?: Such systems should be accessible to Member State's competent authorities.
How is reusability considered?: Sharing and reuse of data will be detailed in the separate initiative on digitalisation of case management in the area of return, readmission and reintegration .
